name: decisions
why: The recorded corpus the `static` backend answers from — what CI runs, with no network and no credential. The three guard states measured live in spikes/classifier/reports/00-live-backend.md F3: `git status --short` allows (risk 0.02), `rm -rf ./build` asks (2.25), and `python3 -c "import shutil; shutil.rmtree('/')"` denies (2.97) — the third being the case the shipped DANGEROUS regex misses entirely. The three share one questions payload and differ only in state, which is why every entry carries the same canonicalSha256: a static backend keyed on the canonical request alone cannot tell them apart, and MUST key on the state too.
